import subprocess, sys

# Final comprehensive test
print("=== FINAL VERIFICATION ===")

# 1. Existing tests pass
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "test_semver.py", "-v", "-c", "/dev/null"], capture_output=True, text=True)
passed = r.returncode == 0
print(f"Existing tests: {'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'} ({r.returncode})")

# 2. STATUS.json exists
import os, json
exists = os.path.exists('STATUS.json')
with open('STATUS.json') as f:
    status = json.load(f)
print(f"STATUS.json: {exists} with R1-R4={status}")
